events.title: Just Rats Demo Release
events.summary: We’ve finally moved on from the playtest and are happy to announce the release of the Just Rats Demo. In this demo, your team is trapped in a small suburb surrounded by pigs. Your objective is to survive the pig invasion by fighting through as many waves as you choose, defeat the boss, and evacuate safely. Thank you for playing the demo. We look forward to your feedback, and we hope you enjoy your time in Just Rats ❤️

events.title: Playtest Release
events.summary: Hello everyone!We're happy to announce that the closed playtest for Just Rats is now live. Version 0.01 is available to play!The current build features one detailed map and a Deathmatch game mode. So grab your friends (or your lovers) and start chasing rats around the neighborhood!As this is an early test version, we're especially interested in bug reports and feedback. events.title: Closed Playtest Announcement
events.summary: We're excited to announce that the closed invitation-only playtest for JUST RATS is coming soon!A selected group of players will get early access to the game and help us test gameplay, balance, performance, and uncover any issues before release.If you're invited, your feedback will play an important role in shaping the future of JUST RATSStay tuned for more details. Cheers,JUST RATS Team 🐁
